common: Animate exactly the same reference creature, preserving its design, palette, anatomy, proportions, equipment and native pixel size. Fixed low top-down front camera, facing South. Fixed 192x192 canvas, stationary root at center, no camera movement, zoom or resize. Crisp native pixel art, flat gray background to remove. Real articulated body motion, no rotating a rigid still image. Full silhouette stays within canvas. No scenery, text, attached projectile or giant magic effects. Finish in the initial neutral stance unless disappearance is explicitly requested.

clips.name: Heavy Ram
clips.action: The huge quadruped briar beast performs ONE heavy charge launch and braking cycle in place. Deep crouch with front and hind joints bending, load weight backward, powerful hind-leg push, heavy chest and head lean forward into a sustained ram pose, then front limbs brace wide and bend under its mass, chest overshoots and settles into neutral. Show separate windup, launch, travel pose and heavy brake. No walking loop, no running in place, no attack swipe. World translation is external; keep the creature rooted in the center.

clips.name: Violent Rush
clips.action: The same quadruped briar beast does ONE violent rushing attack preparation and recovery in place. Aggressive shoulders jerk down, head thrust low, front paws dig in and hindquarters coil, explosive extension into a long low forward-driving ram pose, hold that pose briefly, then forelimbs stamp wide and absorb a forceful braking recoil. Stronger snappier motion than a slow heavy ram. Do not walk or gallop, do not slide across the image. No magic. Keep all limbs and horns consistent.

clips.name: Heavy Claw
clips.action: ONE short heavy front-claw strike from the stationary quadruped monster. Brace three legs, lift its right massive forelimb slightly outward and backward, rotate shoulder and chest, crush the claw down and forward in a compact arc directly in front, then recover onto four limbs. Clear anticipation, contact and recovery. No charge, no locomotion, no magical blast, no extra limb.

clips.name: Crushing Body Strike
clips.action: ONE short-range crushing shoulder and head strike. The quadruped briar beast plants its hind feet and left forelimb, pulls the armored head and shoulder back and slightly up, then drives its chest, brow and shoulder down-forward in a short heavy bodily blow, front knees flex at contact and recover. Distinct from a claw swipe and from a full charge. Stay rooted at the same point, do not run. Preserve all four limbs and thorn armor.

clips.name: Staff Invocation
clips.action: ONE grounded spell cast by the rune archmage. His staff arm lifts the same intact staff upward beside his shoulder, both shoulders and torso straighten and open, free palm gathers inward at chest level, a clear downward staff emphasis and forward palm gesture mark release, then return to the initial stance. Feet fixed, robe reacts subtly. Real elbow and shoulder articulation. No projectile, no beam, no permanent magical ring drawn into the body.

clips.name: Rune Conjuration
clips.action: ONE expressive free-hand rune-conjuring gesture. Keep the intact staff planted low as support. Free hand sweeps across the chest, forearm rises outward, shoulders rotate and robe folds shift, then the palm opens decisively forward to release a spell, chest settles and arm returns. More torso and free-hand motion than a staff raise, stationary feet. No projectile or large attached spell VFX.

clips.name: Rune Dissolve
clips.action: A stationary teleport DEPARTURE AND ARRIVAL cycle of the same rune archmage. First gather staff and free hand close in a deliberate ritual brace, lower head and shoulders, then body becomes briefly entirely absent, then the same model reforms in exactly the same spot in a crouched braced arrival pose and rises back into neutral. No movement to another position inside the canvas. Leave the vanished frames empty. Rune particles will be separate effects; no portal, no scenery, no replacement character.

clips.name: Arcane Blink
clips.action: A fast stationary teleport blink departure/arrival cycle. A quick sharp staff tilt and free-hand flick with a shoulder recoil, then the archmage is fully absent for a short beat, then reappears at the SAME fixed center with bent knees and staff held close, quickly settles back into the identical initial stance. Distinct fast snap timing rather than a slow ritual dissolve. No translation across the frame, no portal or projectile, preserve character identity.

clips.name: Eclipse Channel
clips.action: ONE controlled eclipse-channeling spell cast by the armored herald. Feet planted, crescent shoulders stay intact. Draw the same central astral focus upward from waist toward chest while elbows bend and shoulders lift, hold a deliberate gathering pose, then push the focus and forearms forward to mark release and return to neutral. Cyan seams remain restrained. No projectile, no large halo or explosion, no melee swing.

clips.name: Celestial Release
clips.action: ONE dramatic celestial summoning gesture by the same armored eclipse herald. Wide grounded stance, chest opens strongly, elbows spread and forearms rise as the intact astral focus tilts upward, head lifts slightly, then shoulders and arms thrust forward-down for a distinct release and recover to the original stance. Larger upper-body articulation than a compact channel. No walking, no projectile or giant attached aura, keep crescent shoulder silhouette and visor unchanged.

clips.name: Shadow Collapse
clips.action: A stationary shadow teleport departure and arrival body cycle. The eclipse herald draws elbows and focus inward, bends knees and hunches the chest into a compact braced pose, then vanishes completely for a brief empty interval, then reforms AT THE SAME CENTER from a low guarded arrival pose, opens shoulders and returns to neutral. No actual movement across the image, no flat image shrinking, no extra model. Shadow VFX separate, no portal painted around the body.

clips.name: Eclipse Rift
clips.action: A sharp eclipse-rift teleport body cycle in place. The same herald raises one forearm and turns its astral focus sideways with a clear torso twist as if opening a rift, then steps into a compact guarded pose and fully disappears for a short beat. Reappears at exactly the same root position with a braced foot placement and reverses the arm gesture into neutral. External preview supplies the rift and relocation. Do not draw any portal, no translation across canvas, no replacement armor or additional arms.

clips.name: Orb Charge
clips.action: The ancient stone altar stays absolutely anchored and non-humanoid. ONE orb-casting preparation: carved rune tiles activate in a short sequence, the central circular core iris mechanically opens or rotates slightly, small stone inset segments shift outward by a few pixels, energy gathers as a compact core highlight, a distinct short core pulse marks RELEASE, then the iris closes and stones settle into the original shape. No growing arms, no walking, no projectile leaving the sprite, no beam. All emitted orbs and beams are separate objects.

clips.name: Crystal Pulse
clips.action: The rooted arcane totem stays absolutely anchored, no humanoid body. ONE orb-casting cycle: root braces flex very subtly, the same central crystal tilts or lifts a few pixels between the wooden prongs, carved stone rune insets activate upward, crystal gathers a compact highlight, then a short distinct crystal pulse marks RELEASE, crystal lowers and roots settle back. No extra limbs, no projectile leaving the sprite, no beam, no giant aura. Keep the entire altar design and core position consistent.
